Amy Winehouse: Exploring how life events shaped her music

Life and career

2003 — Debut Album Frank

  • Jazz and hip-hop

  • Popular and well-received among critics

2003 - 2006

  • Struggles with substance abuse

  • Press scrutiny

  • Tumultuous relationship with Blake Fielder-Civil

2006 — Back to Black Released

  • Strongly influenced by heartbreak and addiction

  • 1960s and soul influences

  • Themes of grief and self-destruction

2011 — Winehouse passes away and Lioness: Hidden Treasures is posthumously released

  • Died of alcohol poisoning in London

  • Lioness: Hidden Treasures — Compilation of unreleased material

  • Featured a mix of music spanning her early jazz and later soul-inspired work

Valence

  • Frank was high valence/upbeat

  • Back to Black drops in valence, featuring sadder themes (heartbreak, substance abuse)
